findings.text: follow-on: the eight-module gate exits 1 rather than the 0 the done-when names, because test_re_authoring_reproduces_the_identity_the_package_pins fails; it fails identically at base a72522ec so the added-failure count is zero, but the measure's stated exit status is unmet and the pin and the installed Nova MAST producer have diverged (pin sha256:8df7a0a6c3f6162dbe0f226660bc069f37de8eb69f0f7c80bbfedc2bd4be220c, producer sha256:f20d64dbde63756150fecd5a41d34a0d7a055900877370aae40a594ca7d039d5).

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base a72522ec; 16a7fa4f changes 14 source and test files on the resolution, identity and selection route, and 06099f0a adds the single evidence fragment docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-machine-keyed-selection.html, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names the eight-module pytest gate exiting 0 plus ruff exiting 0, with the base revision's failures recorded so added failures can be judged by delta; ruff.log records "All checks passed!" with EXIT=0, and gate.log records the gate at revision 16a7fa4f as "1 failed, 191 passed" with EXIT=1, the same failure id failing at base a72522ec ("1 failed, 184 passed"), so the manifest's added-failure count of zero is supported even though the literal "exits 0" is unmet.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to key the spine's machine-description selection route by machine with JT-60SA pinned per operating phase; the diff replaces the three PINNED_* constants with PINNED_DESCRIPTIONS (imas_ambix/gs/artifact_resolution.py:123) whose mast entry holds one row and whose jt-60sa entry holds OP1 and OP2 rows, and threads a required machine through resolve_machine_description, default_registry (imas_ambix/gs/machine_identity.py:144), identity_for_shot (imas_ambix/gs/machine_identity.py:227), ArtifactMachineSelector.select (imas_ambix/gs/machine_selection.py:153) and MachineArtifactGeometryReader (imas_ambix/gs/artifact_geometry.py:796), exactly as section 7's selection paragraphs specify.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states status complete, the two commits 16a7fa4f and 06099f0a, changed_paths matching the diff, tests "1 failed, 191 passed (pre-existing failure ...; added-failure count 0)", test_logs gate.log and ruff.log, and negative_control_log negative-control.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; every path in the diff a72522ec..06099f0a (15 files) is inside them, and the declared docs/figures/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-machine-keyed-selection directory is deliberately untouched because the done-when names no figure.

justifications.durability: tests/gs/test_machine_selection.py:34 reddens when the pin resolves the wrong row (negative-control.log: assert 'f4ba9a35aab22485' == '08807c77e7b35487') and tests/gs/test_machine_selection.py:71 checks the pinned rows against freshly authored manifests.
justifications.evidence: gate.log's first line records the revision 16a7fa4f, the tree and the command and its last line is EXIT=1, and the manifest records the added-failure count zero by delta against base a72522ec, but the done-when's stated exit status of 0 is unmet.
justifications.fit: the PinRow frozen dataclass in imas_ambix/gs/artifact_resolution.py:84 follows the module's existing dataclass idiom beside ResolvedArtifact and introduces no version, plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_ambix/gs/artifact_resolution.py:123 PINNED_DESCRIPTIONS holds the per-machine rows (jt-60sa OP1 and OP2) and imas_ambix/gs/machine_selection.py:153 selects by the shot's own physical digest, which is the whole of section 7's selection-paragraph specification.
justifications.reuse: author_jt60sa_machine_artifact (imas_ambix/gs/artifact_resolution.py:112) wraps description_artifact.author_jt60sa_machine_artifacts rather than adding a second producer, and imas_ambix/spine_bench/machine_artifact_arm.py:75 stops re-exporting the retired PINNED_* names.
justifications.scope_discipline: the 15 paths in git diff --name-only a72522ec..06099f0a are all inside the manifest's declared write paths, and no path outside them is touched.
